title: VR-Compassion Cultivation Training
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from a study investigating virtual reality (VR)-based augmentation of compassion cultivation training (CCT). Participants engaged with an immersive VR social environment called Compassion Island, implemented in AltspaceVR, which included a meditation hall, a garden, and a clinic setting where they interacted with live-actor-controlled avatars. The dataset captures neural responses associated with guided meditation, compassion visualization exercises, and simulated social interactions designed to cultivate compassion.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during VR-based compassion cultivation training sessions conducted in AltspaceVR's Compassion Island environment. Sessions included three main components: guided meditation in a meditation hall with breath regulation assistance, compassion visualization exercises in a garden setting, and interactive clinical role-play with a virtual patient character. Participants engaged in free conversation with live actor-controlled avatars representing a guide and a patient.
